page.overview:
What is Golett?

Golett is a light blue-green compact robot-like Pokémon, with yellow lights and a blue diamond with a spiral pattern on its stomach. It has stubby rocks for feet and big, bulky arms. Golett has asymmetrical eyes, which is a characteristic only found in its evolutionary line. Despite its robot-like appearance, Golett is not part -type.

Golett are amicable Pokémon. They are comfortable around humans and will not give them much trouble. They may either fight or flee when they sense danger. They are dutiful creatures that will obediently follow the commands of their trainers—even the ones that don't seem like commands. These Pokémon take orders very literally, so Trainers should be careful not to use figurative speech around them.

Golett evolves into Golurk starting at level 43.

This Pokémon learns no moves by Breeding.
